project: PhotoDay H3 v5 selective scene repair
strategy: Regenerate scenes 01, 03 and 04 as isolated H3 shots at higher native resolution; keep scenes 02 and 05 from the approved v4 source sequence unchanged. Scene 03 was added after frame-by-frame QC exposed the obsolete photographer and an internal composition jump in the approved-v4 segment.

01.purpose: Stable sharp heroine face, clean hair/fur edges, lit moving candle flames and no pearl flare.

03.purpose: Continuous makeup-and-styling shot with exactly three physical women, no old photographer or camera, no internal transition and stable sharp faces.

04.purpose: All faces remain sharp; supplied blonde photographer looks through the viewfinder at the heroine; dark unlit flash remains attached to the hot shoe.

upscale_policy: Reuse v4 settings unchanged: 100% RealESRGAN_x4plus, UnsharpMask radius 0.65 / amount 75 / threshold 2, x264 CRF 12 slow tune film.

rejected_attempts.reason: Candle flames progressively became decorative starburst rays; only clean frames 0-28 were retained and resampled.
The bright panel in the initial flash guide progressively bloomed even though the flash remained attached; guide was corrected to dark non-emissive plastic and take 02 was generated.

rejected_attempts.artifact: approved v4 source frames 97-144 previously reused for scene 03
rejected_attempts.reason: Frame-by-frame review after assembly showed the obsolete background photographer from the prior version and a composition jump from makeup to champagne inside the two-second shot. The full scene is replaced rather than patched at the nominal scene-04 boundary.

notes: The 124-frame H3 length is inside the model's trained range. Only visually approved material is used. Scene 01 uses a contiguous clean 29-frame window resampled to 48 with FILM; scene 04 uses one contiguous 48-frame window from accepted take 02. Scene 03 acceptance fields are populated only after full frame-by-frame review.
